Container.Name: NeedleDrop
Container.Overview: NeedleDrop is a vinyl-style client for Navidrome/OpenSubsonic. Browse your record collection, play albums as Side A / Side B, manually flip the record, and optionally enrich releases with MusicBrainz and Discogs metadata.
Container.Requires: A running Navidrome server reachable from this container. If the /data volume is not writable, ensure /mnt/user/appdata/needledrop is writable by UID/GID 1001:1001.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the NeedleDrop WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent NeedleDrop data, including pressing choices and collection-specific metadata.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: URL NeedleDrop should use to reach Navidrome. Example: http://192.168.1.100:4533. Do not use localhost unless Navidrome is in the same container.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required 64-character random hex secret used to encrypt NeedleDrop sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Discogs Token
Config.Description: Optional Discogs personal access token for richer vinyl pressing metadata.

Config.Name: MusicBrainz User Agent
Config.Description: User-Agent sent to MusicBrainz for metadata lookups.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal directory used by NeedleDrop for persistent application data.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Use true only when NeedleDrop is accessed over HTTPS. Leave false for plain HTTP over LAN or Tailscale.
